Israr Ali vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 November, 2025
Sl. No. 31  HON'BLE ANISH KUMAR GUPTA, J.

1. Heard Shri Nasim Uddin, learned counsel for the applicants, and Smt. Harshita Rani, learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The instant application under Section 528 B.N.S.S. has been filed seeking quashing of order dated 19.07.2024 passed in Criminal Case No. 6260 of 2023 (State vs. Israr Ali) arising out of Case Crime No. 378 of 2022 under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Kotwali Nagar, District- Hamirpur, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,Hamirpur.

entities.text: Israr Ali Vs. State of U.P. and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Following prayer has been made in the said application:
"This application under section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for quashing the charge sheet dated 19.3.2023 and summoning/cognizance order dated 29.5.2023 as well as the entire criminal proceedings against the applicant in Case Crime No. 0378 of 2022 under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, police station Kotwali, District Hamirpur pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, District Hamirpur."

4. However, the said application has been disposed of by this court vide order dated 1.3.2024 on the submission of the learned counsel for the applicant that he is not pressing the application for quashing the proceeding and liberty be granted to move discharge application before the trial court.
Since the instant application has been filed again for the same relief, therefore, proma-facie the instant application is not maintainable.

5. Upon this observation of the Court, learned counsel for the applicant seeks to withdraw the instant application with liberty to appear before the trial court concerned and thereafter make a prayer for referring the dispute to the Mediation Center of the District Court.

6. In view of the above, the instant application is disposed of with liberty to the applicant herein to appear before the trial court within two weeks from today and make a prayer for referring the matter to the Mediation Center.

In case the applicant appears and make a request for referring the matter to the Mediation Center within the stipulated period, the trial court concerned shall dealt with the application so moved by the applicant in accordance with law.

(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) November 4, 2025 o.k.
